cells.tense: The many truths of what is arriving are held here, with the pen still moving.
cells.act: declare the shape of it outward, plainly
cells.ask: Say plainly what you see arriving, once, to someone nearby, without making it a case.
cells.core:
Something is entering, and you are already holding more of it than one clean view can carry. You can do that without losing your footing. The picture keeps its many sides, and you still know which side fits this room. Things make sense when you are in them — not because you simplified, but because you stayed with what was true and said it where it could be heard.

What bends it now is the urge to hold the shape and keep it. The clear thing narrows into a private frame, and the people who could work with it do not get to. Say the shape once, plainly, to someone there. You are not asking permission and not arguing; you are putting the frame where it can be used. What was abundant becomes a shape others can stand in.
cells.sheetLine: You are holding more than one truth, and it can still be said.
cells.verb: Holding many truths at once as they arrive

cells.tense: There is so much arriving that no single heading has been chosen yet.
cells.act: choose which star to steer by and steer
cells.ask: Pick one direction for what is arriving, name it, and steer by it for a day or two.
cells.core:
Everything is arriving at once, and nothing has been chosen as the heading. This many perceptions can be carried or they can turn into a survey that does not land. Direct knowing does not have to invent a case — it lands, and you move. What bends it now is the bracing, because if enough truths are held high, no single one can commit you.

Choose one direction and steer by it. Not forever, not as a claim about your life, just for the next stretch. The rest of what you see does not disappear; it stays heard and stays off the wheel while you face one way. What is arriving needs a direction more than it needs another view. Radiance flows from what was actually developed, not from what was surveyed.
cells.sheetLine: You see everything arriving. Pick one heading and steer by it.
cells.verb: Holding many truths at once as they arrive

cells.tense: What was entering was never fully met, and the door is still being stood at.
cells.act: join someone in the work so the two streams run as one
cells.ask: Bring one piece of what is entering to one other person, and work on it beside them.
cells.core:
The door is behind you and you are hovering at the threshold. Something came in, and it did not get picked up. You are not confused about it; you just have not moved toward what is yours to meet, and that holding pattern is what has gone quiet. The signals are there. The shipping has not happened.

That place cannot be filled by pushing harder. Bring one piece of what is arriving to one other person and work on it beside them. Do not explain it, do not prepare it; do the small shared version of it today. Movement comes from one connection running, not from more thinking. What lands after that will land without argument.
cells.sheetLine: What entered is waiting for you to pick it up.
cells.verb: Holding many truths at once as they arrive

cells.tense: What is entering is being met already, and the one doing it is not saying so.
cells.act: act on the private sense of what is right
cells.ask: When something arrives and you sense the right move, take it once without checking first.
cells.core:
What is entering is already being met by you — you sense what fits, what is yours to take up, what to leave — and you talk about it as though the read were obvious to anyone standing nearby. It is not obvious. It is yours. The compass is doing the deciding while your account says you are only being sensible.

Use the inner sense in one small case before anyone confirms it. Bring the owed thing back, take the right action where no one is watching, and keep the tally to yourself. No public story is needed for the call to have been made. What you sense proves accurate because it got acted on, not because it got announced.
cells.sheetLine: You sense the right move. Make it before you check.
cells.verb: Holding many truths at once as they arrive
